title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. My wife is expecting. She would be delivering in a few days. I have heard that if a person makes niyat that he would name the newborn as Muhammad, then he would be gifted with a son. I had decided in my mind that Insha Allah I would name my first born "Muhammad Imdadullah", with due to respect to the prophet SAS and love for the saint Haji Imdadullah Makki (RAH). But on consulting an aalim, he has said that the name is a mismatch. I'm in a predicament, whether I can add Haji sahab's name to the name Muhammad or not? Please guide me. 2801 views Q. answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 13692 Country: MW Title: Asalaamulaikum, Please give me the meaning for the following names: Aameelah,sahla,faariah abbaad,sahl,qais,marwaan JAZAKALLAH Question: Asalaamulaikum, Please give me the meaning for the following names: Aameelah,sahla,faariah abbaad,sahl,qais,marwaan JAZAKALLAH Answer ID: 13692 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1072/916=D/1430) Aamilah: a woman who works Sahlah: polite, easy, soft soil Abbad: One worshipping very much Sahal: easy, soft Qais: proper name of Majnoon, the lover of Laila Marwan: name of a ruler Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
